title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: alert classification replaces dismissal reasons
notes: claim 57: severity major on a rationale: risk rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout dates, licensing background and role-group controls are supported. The risk rationale should say that no detection change is described, rather than asserting that detection is unchanged; the checklist also names alert filters without a corresponding control row.
